text_block_list.text:
Three years spent with Dream Journey. That 
"journey" has reached a milestone, and...
――Many seasons came and went.

Dream Journey is not in the Trainer's Room 
right now.
Yet, I didn't feel lonely about it either.

"There are meetings, and there are 
partings. Such is the inevitability... of 
a 'journey.'"

Where could she be right now? There is 
simply no way to know.
However—

The "streak of gold" she envisioned. Even 
now, it is undeniably running across this 
world—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Nakayama Festa comes chasing through the 
gap!! Is Nakayama Festa in the lead?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa!! She's neck and neck!! 
Hang in there, Nakayama Festa!! Nakayama 
Festaaa!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa crosses the finish line in 
second place!!!
(WOOOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —Phew...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...It was a good match—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ORAAAAAHHHHHHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Gold Ship from the inside!! 
Gold Ship!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She broke clear, she broke clear!! Gold 
Ship!! The winner is Number 14, Gold 
Shiiiip!
(WOOOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's hear a comment from our 
victor, Gold Ship-san—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: 'Scuse me coming through~!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, so with that said, the Golshi 
Frontline is gonna get super active from 
here on out!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Don't forget to watch the Golshi-chan 
Forecast from your living rooms!! And 
don't forget to like and subscribe!!!
(WOOOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Orfevre makes her move!! 400 meters to 
go!! She takes the lead!!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Burn it into your memory!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She pulls away from the pack!! The final 
steep slope is nothing to her!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
THIS IS IT!! THIS IS IT!!! THIS IS 
ORFEVRE----!!!!
(WOOOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ――This is my gold.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Never forget that—

—Once you turn your eyes to the race, 
she's right there. You can feel her 
hoofprints.

Like the immutable gold of yesteryear. The 
"journey" still continues—

text_block_list.name: Sprightly Elderly Driver
text_block_list.text:
“――――Little lady. We'll be arriving at 
that place of yours real soon.”

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "Thank you very much. As for the bill—"

text_block_list.name: Sprightly Elderly Driver
text_block_list.text:
"I don't need it, I don't need it! —You 
traveled all the way here to such a remote 
place from Japan, didn't ya?"

text_block_list.name: Sprightly Elderly Driver
text_block_list.text:
“That... chazuke talk earlier was plenty 
for me. Maybe I'll try it if I ever visit 
Japan with my grandkid.”

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu, by all means. Allow me to recommend 
some great shops."

text_block_list.name: Sprightly Elderly Driver
text_block_list.text:
"See ya later, young lady! Have a 
wonderful trip!!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "Yes, to you as well. Safe travels."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ......Now then.
What a fine sky...—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —I've been looking for you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: …………Big Sis.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Ooh, Journey!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look up. The sky's looking real nice 
here, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ……You really never change, do you?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: “—So? What did you manage to find?”

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ......Countless changes—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The growth stemming from that... or 
perhaps, a birth...—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Glory truly worthy of praise.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: …………"A single ray of gold."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yet that is... for me...—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The change brought by my "journey." ...Is 
"gold."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Surely, this 'gold' exists... as many 
times over as there are 'journeys'—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
So that's why you said what you did back 
then.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Going on the next "journey," you say.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Haha—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...There are many "journeys." As many as 
there are lives.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone is on a journey.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
This world, everyone... always and 
forever...—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Born, and dying. Continuing, and fading 
away.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: A long, enduring journey—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Your journey was a fun one, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Like a dream.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —Well then, guess I'll get going.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Where to next?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Who knows? Well, time will tell.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: What about you?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ......Haha. Is that so.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Well, see ya later.

...That day, for the first time in a 
while, I brewed a cup of coffee and dabbed 
perfume on my wrists.

"A rich, smoky fragrance tickles the 
nostrils. And then, it sweeps right past."

The days of our "journey," so fleeting... 
yet so dazzling—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ――...Well now, Journey.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
There are all kinds of "journeys" out 
there, aren't there? In this world of 
ours.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Continuing to walk all the way to that 
inevitable end, that too is what it means 
to 'journey.'"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Also, having a place to return to...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: I suppose that's part of the journey too.
